claim: GET /mail/* (feat/mail-people-and-threads-read, founder /goal 2026-11-07) is signed-in only: mail.controller.ts carries @UseGuards(JwtAuthGuard) and no @Roles anywhere, so every member of the house reads its vendor mail (draft ADR 0357 answer 3, PR #747). What a role changes is decided in mail.read-rules.ts withholdsHouseLetters: only 'owner' and 'manager' see HOUSE_DRAFT / HOUSE_CANCELLED letters; any other role, and a token with none, gets the withheld view (ADR 0167). Proven by mail.controller.spec.ts and mail.read-rules.spec.ts, each mutation-tested.
verify: python3 -c "import re,sys; R=lambda p: re.sub(r'(?m)^[ \t]*//.*','',re.sub(r'/[*][\s\S]*?[*]/','',open(p).read())); c=R('apps/api-gateway/src/conversations/mail.controller.ts'); r=R('apps/api-gateway/src/conversations/mail.read-rules.ts'); sys.exit(0 if '@UseGuards(JwtAuthGuard)' in c and '@Controller(\'mail\')'.replace(chr(39),chr(34)) in c and '@Roles(' not in c and 'new Set([\'owner\', \'manager\'])'.replace(chr(39),chr(34)) in r and 'withholdsHouseLetters' in R('apps/api-gateway/src/conversations/mail.service.ts') else 1)"

claim: Every /mail read takes the house from the verified token and nowhere else: mail.controller.ts reads no restaurantId query parameter, and a session that names no house is a 403 ('This session names no restaurant.') before any read. Proven at the HTTP seam by mail.controller.spec.ts (?restaurantId=<other house> is ignored on all four routes).
verify: python3 -c "import re,sys; R=lambda p: re.sub(r'(?m)^[ \t]*//.*','',re.sub(r'/[*][\s\S]*?[*]/','',open(p).read())); c=R('apps/api-gateway/src/conversations/mail.controller.ts'); sys.exit(0 if 'restaurantId' in c and not re.search(r'@Query\([^)]*restaurant', c, re.I) and 'throw new ForbiddenException(' in c and c.count('houseOf(user)')==4 else 1)"

claim: The six functions of migration the_mail_list_is_read_by_person (mail_letter_rows, mail_thread_states, list_mail_people, list_mail_threads, mail_inbox_summary, mail_thread_letters) are STABLE SECURITY INVOKER with SET search_path = '', revoked from PUBLIC, anon and authenticated, and EXECUTE granted to service_role only. The gateway calls them with the service-role client after taking the house from the token; a browser cannot call them. claim: In mail_letter_rows (the one place mail_thread_states and the other mail functions get them), a letter's `visible` and `owes` flags are COALESCEd to false. Without that an outbound row with no status and no sent_at makes `visible` NULL, and the window `ORDER BY visible DESC` sorts NULL first, ranking an unsent draft as the thread's last letter. Found by the 2,000-row proof on 2026-11-07, which counted 141 waiting threads where an independent count found 158.
verify: python3 -c "import re,sys; Q=lambda p: re.sub(r'--[^\n]*','',open(p).read()); q=Q('supabase/migrations/20270421143700_the_mail_list_is_read_by_person.sql'); f=q[q.index('FUNCTION public.mail_letter_rows('):]; f=f[:f.index('\\x24\\x24;')]; sys.exit(0 if re.search(r'COALESCE\(lower\(c\.direction::text\) = \'inbound\'\s*OR \(lower[^;]*?IS NOT NULL\)\)\), false\)', f) and re.search(r'COALESCE\(lower\(c\.direction::text\) = \'inbound\'\s*AND c\.status::text IS DISTINCT FROM \'DELIVERED\'(\s*AND c\.status::text IS DISTINCT FROM \'DISCARDED\')?, false\)', f) and 'FROM public.mail_letter_rows(' in q[q.index('FUNCTION public.mail_thread_states('):] else 1)"
